status.en: 49 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Tehran, Gulf Of Oman and Minab.
status.nb: 49 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Teheran, Omanbukta og Minab.

summary.en: The United States recently struck Iran's Qeshm Island and disabled a commercial vessel attempting to run a blockade in the Gulf of Oman, while Iran launched a missile that hit a building in Tel Aviv. Iran continues to use the Strait of Hormuz as leverage in the regional confrontation. The United States has offered a $20 million reward for information on Iran's nuclear program, and France warned of a response to a cyberattack on supermarkets blamed on Iran. The conflict has already caused 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
